evidence: All 51 criteria (1 render, 2 constraints, 36 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual) were compared pairwise for shared graded observables, subsumption and incompatible demands. (1) No pair demands incompatible products. The only tension in the brief, Tab indenting code versus leaving the editor by keyboard, is resolved in the wording: cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus accepts a non-Tab exit 'unless the ordinary Tab key does it, the app must show on screen which keys do', and cw_block_indent_undo tests Tab only with a selection. Eval refusal (cw_dynamic_code_refused) does not conflict with inline handlers (cw_html_preview, cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget), and fetch rejection (cw_preview_isolation) is not needed by any other criterion. As positive evidence, the scripted golden on these exact bytes records true for every gate, functional and polish criterion (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json, persist-after.json; artifact hashes verified against the raw evidence index), so a single app satisfies them all. (2) Places where sibling criteria could have graded the same observable are carved out explicitly. The carve-outs cover the both-modifiers leg (multi_caret_delete and same_line_carets: 'whether both modifiers work is scored elsewhere'; it is graded only in multi_caret_typing_atomic) and Undo in same_line_carets ('Undo behaviour is not judged here'). They also cover leftover first-run preview output (basic_run_output defers it to run_starts_fresh_document), the run-end reason (output_before_failure_kept: 'scored by other criteria'), last-good picture return (time_limit_recovery and stop_cancels_pending_work defer it to last_good_recovery, which in turn defers later valid Runs), conflict feedback (stale_save_keeps_draft defers it to stale_save_refused), repeat-restore (history_restore_adds_revision defers it to restore_request_repeat_safe) and Run correctness in the polish criteria. The three visual likert items separate typography, pane arrangement and component finish, and readability excludes token correctness. (3) The prompts forbid verdict inheritance: functional prompt.md:12-13 says 'Never carry a verdict across criteria. Two similar criteria are two checks' and 'Score each criterion independently'; polish and visual prompts say the same. (4) Each remaining shared leg maps to a separate public sentence. Examples are ui.md 'Replace current changes only the current match and then moves to the match that follows it' versus 'Replace current never lands on text it has just inserted', and behaviour.md 'make the other's old-revision Save fail without changing the saved record or discarding that tab's dirty draft'. Hashes of the frozen judge.toml files, instruction.md, behaviour.md and ui.md match the run manifest. NOTES (not defects; each is a precondition or positive control that REVIEW_POLICY requires, and none double-counts an observable for an app that implements the precondition): (a) Refusal of B's stale Save is the observable of cw_stale_save_refused and also a precondition in cw_stale_save_keeps_draft ('Fails ... if B's Save was not refused'), so a last-write-wins app loses 3.0 functional weight. REVIEW_POLICY says refusal and dirty-draft preservation are different outcomes and a negative needs a control, and a kept draft cannot be observed without a refused Save. (b) 'First restore adds a revision' appears in both cw_history_restore_adds_revision and cw_restore_request_repeat_safe, where it is the working control. (c) The storage-cleared readback in the gate cw_shared_saved_record is repeated inside cw_save_reload_restart. Because the gate has zero weight and is all-or-nothing, this is not double-counted in the weighted sum. (d) cw_save_reload_restart and cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft use arrow keys to place a mid-line marker, and save_reload_restart 'Fails if the marker could not be typed inside the first line'. Arrow navigation is graded separately in cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers, so an editor with broken Left/Right would also lose persistence credit. This is bounded setup coupling (P3 at most). (e) An app whose Replace current does not advance fails both cw_replace_current and probably cw_replace_self_containing_text. The two map to separate brief sentences, and an app that advances but rescans inserted text separates them. (f) An endless loop that is never ended cascades into time_limit_recovery, output_before_failure_kept and last_good_recovery. That cascade comes from a catastrophic defect and does not mean the criteria share one observable. Scope: this is a static design review plus scripted golden evidence. No configured judge run exists for these bytes, and none is needed to decide independence.
